thread:
marta: Heads up - acme reported a sustained p99 spike ~15m ago, they see 2-3s -> 9-12s on gen endpoints. customer says "we're getting timeouts in production". logs show request pileup at ingress.
rajiv: Ack. Any correlation with deploys or model changes?
sam: No deploys from infra last 30m. metrics -> ingress queue length jumped; worker saturation on gpu-pool-3.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-7543. Pager sent to eng-oncall.
marta: Repro steps from CS: curl -> POST /v1/generate with 6 concurrent streams for ~10s triggers their timeouts. They included a curl with an api-key.
lee: Can you paste the curl (sanitized) and a small window of logs? I want to see 429 vs long tail 200s.
marta: sanitized curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-std-1","input":"long prompt..","max_tokens":512}'
```
marta: Logs from ingress (snip):
```
2026-03-17T12:34:01Z INFO request_received tenant=acme id=34f
2026-03-17T12:34:02Z WARN enqueue wait_ms=812 tenant=acme
2026-03-17T12:34:03Z WARN enqueue wait_ms=1204 tenant=acme
2026-03-17T12:34:04Z ERROR dispatch_timeout tenant=acme queue_wait_ms=2200
```
rajiv: queue_wait_ms creeping >2s, worker CPU/GPU utilization at 98% on gpu-pool-3. Looks like sustained saturation not transient.
sam: Any large model load/evictions? KV cache pressure?
lee: No recent model loads. But autoscaler didn't spin up extra nodes - config has cooldown=10m and we hit scale limit for that pool.
marta: Customer is on Dedicated-small, single reserved pool. They expect steady throughput but aren't on burst capacity.
rajiv: Short-term mitigation: enable a temporary admission cap for high-cost requests from that tenant and return 429 with Retry-After. We can also lower max_tokens for that tenant via per-tenant policy.
sam: I can push an emergency policy: cap concurrent requests for acme to 20 and set max_tokens=256. That should reduce per-request time.
lee: Also add tenant-level prefix caching for repeated prompts? But that's medium term.
marta: CS wants a customer-friendly message. Suggested message: "We're temporarily limiting concurrent heavy requests to restore latency; please retry in 30s. Contact CS for priority."
rajiv: I'll open a quick rollout for policy change. Sam, can you craft the policy JSON? Use route overrides -> admission {concurrency:20, max_tokens:256}.
sam: Policy blob ready:
```
{
  "tenant_id":"acme",
  "overrides":{ "concurrency_limit":20, "max_tokens":256, "burst_allowed":false }
}
```
sam: Applying to prod in 2m. Will monitor queue length and p95/p99.
oncall-bot: Rollout started by sam at 12:45:18Z. Canary=10%.
lee: If p99 drops but throughput suffers for customer, we'll offer scheduled burst window or recommend Dedicated+burst add-on.
marta: CS update draft: "We've applied a temporary limit to heavy requests while we scale capacity; you may see 429s for short periods. We're monitoring and will follow up." Want me to send?
rajiv: Wait 5m and collect p95/p99 metrics. If stable, send.
sam: Canary shows queue length down 60% in canary hosts. p99 across canary down from 11s -> 3.2s.
marta: Good. I'll hold message and update once global rollout complete.
lee: Follow-up actions: 1) increase autoscaler max_nodes for gpu-pool-3; 2) add tenant burst config as paid add-on; 3) improve alerting on sustained queue_wait_ms>1500ms.
rajiv: Filed infra ticket INF-324 for autoscale limit bump. I'll add a temporary exception for acme until next maintenance window.
sam: Rolling to 100% now.
oncall-bot: Rollout complete at 12:51:02Z.
sam: Post-rollout: p99 overall for acme ~2.8s, queue length back to baseline.
marta: Sent CS update. Customer replied: "thanks — saw improvements, please keep us posted." :thumbsup:
lee: Keep this thread for postmortem notes. We should link with incident INC-2026-7543.
marta: Noting root cause = reserved pool hitting max_nodes limit + no burst capacity. Mitigations = tenant admission caps, autoscaler limit bump, and offering a burst SLA.
rajiv: I'll draft short postmortem and recommended config for Dedicated tenants. Assigning to eng-platform for autoscaler change.
marta: Thanks everyone. Closing triage unless new regressions appear.
